bagPolicy.summary: Small bags are normally allowed; larger messenger bags and backpacks must be checked. The venue checks bags for free, and artist requirements can vary.
prohibited: Large bags on the concert floor
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: First Avenue has no private parking lot; a surface lot at First Avenue and Eighth Street is closest, with the Mayo ramp across Seventh Street and the A, B and C ramps nearby.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ does not give a designated rideshare pickup location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue has bar service; its FAQ does not publish a fixed concession menu.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Contact the office about accessible accommodations at least 24 hours before the show, or by 5 p.m. Friday for a weekend show. Limited general-admission seating is first come, first served.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The First Avenue FAQ does not give a general re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Guests need valid photo ID to claim will-call tickets. Ticket sales are also available at the adjacent Depot Tavern ticket window on Wednesdays through Saturdays from 4 to 11 p.m.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: A valid photo ID is required to enter; concerts list their own door times. Large bags must be checked before admission.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
